description: This file contains the implementation of the AliasManager class for managing URL path aliases in Drupal, including methods for retrieving and caching path aliases, handling language-specific mappings, and managing path prefix lists.

classes.name: Drupal\path_alias\AliasManager
classes.description: Default implementation of the alias management system for URL path aliases in Drupal.

methods.name: setCacheKey
methods.description: Sets the cache key for the preload alias cache (deprecated).

methods.name: writeCache
methods.description: Writes to the per-page system path cache (deprecated).

methods.name: getPathByAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the system path corresponding to a given alias, considering language context.

methods.name: getAliasByPath
methods.description: Retrieves the alias for a given system path, considering language context.

methods.name: cacheClear
methods.description: Clears the alias cache, either entirely or for a specific source.

methods.name: pathAliasPrefixListRebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the path prefix list, optionally for a specific path.

methods.name: pathAliasWhitelistRebuild
methods.description: Deprecated method that rebuilds the path alias prefix list, now redirects to pathAliasPrefixListRebuild.
